about: The fixed music vocabulary. A signal must use one of these dimension/slug pairs; anything else is filed as other/<word> and counted, so the list grows only when Krish merges a change to this file. Polarity is per signal: he can like the bassline of a track whose vocal he dislikes.

groove.percussive_groove: the groove is carried by percussion
groove.melodic_percussion: pitched percussion: marimba, kalimba, tuned percs
groove.textured_snare: a snare with a texture layered on top

harmony.synth_chords: synth chord stabs or pads as the harmony
harmony.call_and_response_melody: a melodic call answered, e.g. 3 bars call, 1 bar answer

sound_design.signature_fx_hit: a recurring signature hit that marks the phrase

arrangement.long_intro: more than 16 bars before full energy
arrangement.held_energy: at full energy for 70% or more of the track
arrangement.solo_tease: tease an instrument for 8 bars before its solo
arrangement.contrast_moments: moments that give the ear a break from the main instrument

mix.warm_low_end: low or sub band is the loudest
mix.soft_top: air band 18 dB or more below the loudest band
mix.airy_top: air band within 14 dB of the loudest band
